answer: Because the hollow measurement is bound to the ocean signature, the cedar audit verifies every quote and a replayed one fails. The inference runs inside an enclave that produces a 132 bit measurement of the code and data it executed, and the answer is accepted only if that measurement matches the published build. A farm that substitutes a trivial script for real reasoning cannot produce the quote, so it forfeits for the enclave anyway and gets nothing. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
